name: @daanvandenbergh/claudekit
description: Reusable Claude Code skills (TypeScript audits, whole-project security audit, SEO, agent memory) and CLAUDE.md rule snippets. Content-only, no build step: symlink a skill into .claude/skills and @-import rules into your CLAUDE.md.
author: Daan van den Bergh

scripts.push-and-publish: git add -A && git commit -m 'Updates' && npm run release
scripts.release: npm version patch && git push -u origin main --follow-tags
